title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen on 14.10.2026 in the Second Session.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 13/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 14.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 13/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 14.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen would not be
available in the second session.
(2) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would sit
Single and take up the notified matters in the second
session.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
